Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full Meet-Your-Attorney payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Meet your attorney","subtitle":"Matched to your matter - book a free consult","attorneys":[{"id":"vale","name":"Marcus Vale","title":"Managing Partner","focus":"Personal Injury & Litigation","photo":"lawyer-1","years":22,"rating":4.9,"casesWon":"500+ cases","bar":"CA #148203","blurb":"Trial-tested advocate for serious injury and negligence claims."},{"id":"tanaka","name":"Kenji Tanaka","title":"Associate","focus":"Business & Immigration","photo":"lawyer-2","years":8,"rating":4.8,"casesWon":"120+ matters","bar":"CA #276514","blurb":"Guides founders and families through formation, contracts and visas."},{"id":"shaw","name":"Eleanor Shaw","title":"Partner","focus":"Family & Estate Planning","photo":"lawyer-3","years":25,"rating":5.0,"casesWon":"600+ cases","bar":"CA #093117","blurb":"Compassionate counsel for divorce, custody, wills and trusts."}],"submitText":"Book a consult","submitValue":"I would like to book with"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading above the attorney list. Defaults to 'Meet your attorney'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short supporting line under the title, e.g. how the attorneys were matched to the visitor's matter. - 'attorneys' (array, recommended): the matched attorneys, rendered as selectable cards. If empty or omitted the card shows a neutral sample in test mode (never blank). Each attorney object: - 'id' (string, recommended): stable identifier; sent back with the attorney's name when the visitor books. - 'name' (string, required): the attorney's full name. - 'title' (string, optional): role, e.g. 'Managing Partner'. Rendered together with 'focus' as '<title> · <focus>'. - 'focus' (string, optional): practice focus, e.g. 'Personal Injury & Litigation'. - 'photo' (string, optional): a full hosted headshot image URL. OMIT it unless you have a real image URL — the card then shows the attorney's initials instead (the 'lawyer-1'/'lawyer-2'/'lawyer-3' values above are placeholders and will render as initials). - 'initials' (string, optional): 1-2 letters shown when there is no photo; defaults to the initials of 'name'. - 'years' (number, optional): years of experience; rendered as '<years> yrs'. - 'rating' (number 0-5, optional): star rating; rendered to one decimal, e.g. 4.9. - 'casesWon' (string, optional): matters handled, e.g. '500+ cases'. - 'bar' (string, optional): bar admission, e.g. 'CA #148203'. - 'blurb' (string, optional): a one- to two-line description of the attorney. - 'submitText' (string, optional): label for the book button; defaults to 'Book with <first name>' once an attorney is chosen. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the base message sent back to the agent when the visitor books; the chosen attorney's name is appended to it (e.g. 'I would like to book with Marcus Vale'). This card shows administrative attorney-profile information only. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
